title: 北京市公安局公安交通管理局关于2026北京马拉松比赛期间对部分道路采取临时交通管理措施的通告（2026年第28号）
publisher: 北京市公安局公安交通管理局
claims: The 2026 Beijing Marathon is held on Sunday 18 October, starting at Tiananmen Square and finishing on the Landscape Avenue in the Olympic Park central area.

The route runs via Tiananmen Square East Side Road, East/West Chang'an Avenue, Fuxingmen Outer Street, Fuxing Road, Xinxing Bridge, West Third Ring Middle Road auxiliary road, Huayuan Bridge, Linglong Road, Landianchang South Road, Landianchang North Road, North Fourth Ring West and Middle auxiliary roads, Zhixin Bridge, Zhixin East Road, Zhixin Road, Xueyuan Road, Xueqing Road, Shibanfang South Road, Kecui Road, Lincui Road, North Fifth Ring Middle auxiliary road, Aolin West Road, the Speed Skating Hall north road, internal road and south road, Aolin West Road again, Kecui Road again, Aolin West Road again, North Fifth Ring Middle auxiliary road again, Aolin East Road, Kecui South Road, the North Central Axis Landscape Avenue, Datun North Road, Hujing East Road and Datun Road before the finish on the North Central Axis Landscape Avenue.
The full distance is 42.195 km and the race occupies about six hours.
Closures begin at 22:00 on 17 October on the east and west side roads of Tiananmen Square.
The Chang'an Avenue closure from Nanchizi South entrance to Fuxingmen Bridge starts at 07:20 on race day.
Fuxingmen Outer Street and Fuxing Road close from 07:30, the West Third Ring auxiliary road from 07:35, Linglong Road from 07:45 and Landianchang from 07:50.

The North Fourth Ring auxiliary roads close from 07:55, Zhixin East Road from 08:05, Zhixin Road from 08:10, Xueyuan Road and Xueqing Road from 08:15, Shibanfang South Road and Kecui Road from 08:20, Lincui Road and the Speed Skating Hall roads from 08:25.

North Fifth Ring south auxiliary road closes from 08:30, Aolin West Road from 08:35, Kecui Road both directions from 08:40, the North Fifth Ring south auxiliary road again from 08:45, Aolin East Road and Beichen East Road from 08:50, Kecui South Road from 08:55.
From 09:00 pedestrians are barred from the North Central Axis Landscape Avenue section leading to the finish; Datun North Road, Hujing East Road and Datun Road close from 09:05.
No vehicles may be parked on the closed roads.
Vehicles and pedestrians at junctions along the course must obey traffic police and must not cross while race vehicles or runners are passing.
Reopening times are decided by the traffic management department according to how the race progresses.

Alternative routes named in the notice include Taijichang Street, Qianmen East/West Street, Lianshi Road, Fushi Road, the Third Ring Road, Zizhuyuan Road, Fucheng Road, the Fourth Ring Road, Haidian South Road, Zhichun Road, the Badaling expressway, Tsinghua East Road, Zhanchunyuan West Road, Wangzhuang Road, Shuangqing Road and Datun Road.
